intro: Eight sources, about a thousand records, and most of them are ordinary business. Connect them one at a time. Watch which signals find their needles, check the source cards for rows that could not be parsed, and look hard at the merge proposals: one of them is wrong.
finale: Not stolen accounts and not the risk model. A seller was buying from itself: two registrations on one payout account, forty day-old accounts on three devices, the welcome promo, and stolen cards. The tickets were the real cardholders noticing. The merge you had to reject was a different company with a similar name.
